title: Flower Pot Making Workshop (September)
source_quote: Flower Pot Making Workshop | Sunday, 27 September | A one-day pottery workshop dedicated to making flower pots in the studio garden.
evidence_sentence: The workshop description does not mention firing, kiln, or pit; it focuses on hand-building techniques outdoors.
evidence_quote: Participants can learn the basics of hand-building in a relaxed, outdoor environment.
